name: Lucha Throwdown
detailed_description:
Lucha Throwdown

The Lore of the Mask Lives On…  

Step into the ring and onto the battlefield in Lucha Throwdown — a high-octane Card Battler, where legendary Luchadores clash to defend Earth from an ancient evil!

The cursed El Abysmo mask has been unearthed, unleashing a dark force upon the world. Now, a coalition of Lucha legends must rise. Play as iconic Luchador champions, Ultima Quetzal, Muertito, Babaloo and Shango, each bringing their signature style, spirit, and power to the fight.

- Train with Champions. Battle their Jefes.

- Outplay opponents with fast-paced card combat that captures the intensity of real lucha libre action.

- Thrilling multiplayer or embark on your solo journey to glory.

The Ultimate Showdown of Strategy & Strength

Each match is a full-on simulation of high-flying wrestling action, where signature moves, devastating combos, and tactical mastery decide the victor. Customize your stable, collect powerful decks, and unleash the fiercest finishing moves.

- Created by the award-winning developer behind classic THQ wrestling games

- Art by Demente Studios, Mexico’s animation powerhouse

- Immersive audio by Guadalajara’s Kapara Sound

- Narrative crafted by the director of Neverwinter Nights

Lucha Throwdown isn’t just a game — it’s a legacy.

Are you ready to wear the mask and defend the Earth?

short_description: Lucha Throwdown is a fast-paced cross-platform Card Battler where legendary Luchadores Ultima Quetzal, Muertito, Babaloo and Shango battle El Abysmo’s evil horde. Train, strategize, and unleash combos to defend Earth in solo or online multiplayer modes!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 17 or i9 Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX3070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel i5 or Apple Silicon M1
